hero.name: Sébastien Legros
hero.summary: Today I design both web applications and business software. Frontend, backend, desktop and data: React, Blazor, C#, WPF, WinForms, DevExpress, SQL Server, XAF/XPO and robust application architecture.
hero.eyebrow: Full-stack engineer based in Reunion Island
hero.intro: I work across the full product chain, from architecture to production, with a strong focus on readability, maintainability and business impact.
hero.availability: Available for full-stack, backend or technical lead roles.

0.label: Arrival
0.title: First, a clear, calm and readable presence.
0.body: I wanted the opening to feel more like an intentional presentation page than a noisy landing page: centered portrait, short copy, a clear tone and a reason to keep going.

1.label: Structure
1.title: Then the profile, the stack and the intent settle into place.
1.body: As you scroll, the useful blocks appear progressively: identity, role, technologies and hierarchy. Nothing drops all at once; each layer arrives when it should.

2.label: Project
2.title: Finally, the page shifts into concrete work: case study, imagery and contact.
2.body: Going down assembles a fuller interface. Going back up naturally undoes it. The portfolio behaves like a reversible experience rather than a static page.

visual.welcomeTitle: A simple message, a portrait, a direction.
visual.welcomeBody: No unnecessary noise. Just a clear presence that makes you want to keep reading.
visual.profileRole: React, Blazor, C#, WPF, WinForms, SQL Server
visual.caseTitle: Content lands better once the structure is there.
visual.caseBody: When the foundation is readable, projects, impact and contact can be revealed with much more rhythm.
visual.finalCta: Need a product to structure, ship or clean up?

about.title: An approach shaped by clarity, product thinking and execution
about.subtitle: I favor systems that stay easy to evolve, interfaces that stay readable, and technical decisions that genuinely support the product.
about.body: I enjoy building real-world web applications: back-offices, business platforms, APIs, payment flows, content systems, integrations and internal tools. My goal is to turn a fuzzy need into something usable, stable and clean to maintain over time.

build.title: Design the right thing
build.description: I start from the actual need, the user flow and the business constraints before committing to implementation details.

scale.title: Build it cleanly
scale.description: Structure, naming, controlled technical debt and codebases the team can pick up without friction matter a lot to me.

ship.title: Ship with confidence
ship.description: CI/CD, Docker, APIs, perceived quality and interface polish: the finish matters as much as the feature itself.
